SELECT mpcr.id, mpcr.process_type, CASE
WHEN mpcr.process_type = 1 THEN '零件' WHEN mpcr.process_type = 2 THEN '构件' WHEN mpcr.process_type = 16 THEN '部件' ELSE NULL END AS process_type_name, mpcr.conversion_rate, mpcr.process_ids, GROUP_CONCAT( mbp.NAME SEPARATOR ',' ) AS process_names FROM mes_process_conversion_rate mpcr LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON FIND_IN_SET( mbp.id, mpcr.process_ids ) > 0 WHERE mpcr.bool_delete_enum = 0 and mpcr.artifact_class_id = #{artifactClassId} GROUP BY mpcr.id
